thread:
maya: Quick proposal — followups are slipping and recurring patterns are getting missed. I sketched a compact handoff + timeline template and a lightweight recurring-incident signal so owners don't get buried. PTAL.

henry: love it, can you paste the template?

maya: sure — short version:

```
1) 48h: initial owner assigned + triage notes (include rollback decision owner)
2) 5d: remediation plan with scope + primary + secondary owner
3) 2w: in-progress check-in (blockers, ETA, status: green/yellow/red)
4) 30d: closure + regression test + ops doc update
Recurring-review: if same failure mode appears twice in 90d -> escalate to SRE lead and schedule root-cause drill.
```

liam: suggest adding an explicit 'rollback decision owner' at 48h. we've had unclear rollbacks during shims.

jen: Also add automated calendar reminders tied to action owners + a small dashboard tile for overdue items.

owen: For IC rotation — propose rotating weekly across ENG teams, with a single named backup. Keeps load low and spreads learning. Draft schedule here: https://internal/redwood/incident-rotation (WIP).

sarah: Can we make the reminders surface in the Console as well? product teams need visibility for customer comms.

maya: yes — propose two hooks: 1) incident-bot posts "followup due" in channel and DMs the owner, 2) Console shows pending postmortem actions per owner with due dates.

henry: +1. Also please add a simple CSV export for leaders/PMs so timelines can be attached to customer follow-ups.

liam: timeline cadence seems reasonable. who will own the pilot and metrics?

maya: I'll volunteer to run a 4-week pilot with the current oncall cohort. tracking plan: action closure rate, median time-to-assign, % repeat incidents (same failure mode). will post weekly summaries. anyone else volunteer to help?

jen: I'll instrument the metrics and add a small dashboard (SLO-like view for remediation velocity).

owen: I'll own the rotation calendar and update the runbook with the new handoff checklist.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled — first pilot kickoff: Mon 2024-12-02 10:00 PST :calendar: (will DM assigned owners 48h before each checkpoint).

maya: thanks all — putting kickoff on the calendar now and will drop the short template into #eng-oncall before Monday. :thumbsup:
